examples.chinese: 我愛吃水果。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ ài chī shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: I love eating fruit.

examples.chinese: 你要水嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shuǐ ma?
examples.english: Do you want water?

examples.chinese: 這些水果，有的不甜，我不想吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ, yǒude bù tián, wǒ bù xiǎng chī.
examples.english: Some of this fruit are not sweet, I do not want to eat them.

examples.chinese: 我現在不餓，只想吃一點兒水果。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài bú è, zhǐ xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: I am not hungry now, I just want some fruit.

examples.chinese: 醫生說，我應該多喝水，不需要吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, bù xūyào chī yào.
examples.english: The doctor said I should drink more water and don't need to take medicine.

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: 便利商店的服務有賣票、收電話費和水電費等。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de fúwù yǒu mài piào, shōu diànhuàfèi hé shuǐdiànfèi děng.
examples.english: The services at the convenience store include selling tickets, collecting telephone bills, and water and electricity bills, etc.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.
examples.english: Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor.

examples.chinese: 這個社區的周圍有山有水，空氣也很好，這樣的生活環境很適合退休的人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèqū de zhōuwéi yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ, kōngqì yě hěn hǎo, zhèyàng de shēnghuó huánjìng hěn shìhé tuìxiū de rén.
examples.english: The neighborhood of this community has mountains and water, and the air is also very good; such a living environment is very suitable for retired people.

examples.chinese: 那個地區昨天夜裡突然停水、停電，還好今天中午就恢復正常了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge dìqū zuótiān yèlǐ tūrán tíngshuǐ, tíngdiàn, hái hǎo jīntiān zhōngwǔ jiù huīfù zhèngcháng le.
examples.english: That area suddenly had a water cut and power outage last night, but fortunately it returned to normal by noon today.

examples.chinese: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.
examples.english: It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。
examples.pinyin: Yì tīngshuō táifēng kuài lái le, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù qù chāoshì qiǎnggòu shūcài, shuǐguǒ, pàomiàn děng shíwù.
examples.english: As soon as they heard that a typhoon was coming, many people rushed to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruit, instant noodles, and other foods.

examples.chinese: 這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yīlián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ, zàochéng hěnduō dìqū yānshuǐ, sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le.
examples.english: It rained for five days in a row in this city, causing flooding in many areas, and one third of the roads are impassable.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，小感冒只要多喝水、多休息就行了，不需要看病、吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, xiǎo gǎnmào zhǐyào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi jiù xíng le, bù xūyào kànbìng, chī yào.
examples.english: Generally speaking, for a minor cold, you just need to drink more water and rest more; you don't need to see a doctor or take medicine.

examples.chinese: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng rénmen shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn tígāo, kāishǐ zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí shí, xiūxián huódòng yě jiù gēnzhe duō le qǐlái.
examples.english: When people's standard of living rises and they begin to value quality of life, leisure activities then increase accordingly.

examples.chinese: 市長解決了不少這個城市的生活問題，因此民眾的生活水準也大大提高了。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiějué le bùshǎo zhège chéngshì de shēnghuó wèntí, yīncǐ mínzhòng de shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě dàdà tígāo le.
examples.english: The mayor solved quite a few of this city's living problems, therefore the people's standard of living has also greatly improved.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 人人都喜歡薪水高、離家近、輕鬆的工作，不過這往往只是一個夢。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xǐhuan xīnshuǐ gāo, lí jiā jìn, qīngsōng de gōngzuò, búguò zhè wǎngwǎng zhǐshì yí ge mèng.
examples.english: Everyone likes a job with a high salary, close to home, and easy, but this is often just a dream.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

examples.chinese: 前天的強烈颱風帶來了大雨，很多地方都淹水了。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān de qiángliè táifēng dài lái le dàyǔ, hěn duō dìfāng dōu yānshuǐ le.
examples.english: The strong typhoon the day before yesterday brought heavy rain, and many places were flooded.

examples.chinese: 這座城市不但交通十分便利，生活水準也很高，大家都想搬來這裡住。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì bùdàn jiāotōng shífēn biànlì, shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě hěn gāo, dàjiā dōu xiǎng bān lái zhèlǐ zhù.
examples.english: Not only is transportation in this city extremely convenient, but the standard of living is also very high; everyone wants to move here to live.

examples.chinese: A:你說老闆下個月要提高每個人的薪水，沒騙我吧？ B:這個消息是從他的口中說出來的，當然是真的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō lǎobǎn xià gè yuè yào tígāo měi gè rén de xīnshuǐ, méi piàn wǒ ba? B: Zhège xiāoxi shì cóng tā de kǒu zhōng shuō chūlái de, dāngrán shì zhēn de.
examples.english: A: You said the boss is going to raise everyone's salary next month—you're not fooling me, are you? B: This news came out of his own mouth; of course it's true.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day.

examples.chinese: 想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ jiùshì duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, the most effective way is to exercise more, eat fewer sweets, and eat more vegetables and fruit.

examples.chinese: 大信覺得這個公司的薪水跟福利都不好，於是決定換工作。
examples.pinyin: Dàxìn juéde zhège gōngsī de xīnshuǐ gēn fúlì dōu bù hǎo, yúshì juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Daxin felt that this company's salary and benefits were both bad, so he decided to change jobs.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

examples.chinese: 今天我要帶一些水果去看他，也會跟他說今天的功課。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yào dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn tā, yě huì gēn tā shuō jīntiān de gōngkè.
examples.english: Today, I am going to take some fruit to visit him and also inform him about the homework today.

items.wordHook: A central stream rushes between four splashing droplets → 水(water).

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 聽說下星期一我們要用別的教室，你知道是哪間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xià xīngqīyī wǒmen yào yòng bié de jiàoshì, nǐ zhīdào shì nǎ jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: I heard that next Monday we will use a different classroom; do you know which classroom it is?

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 聽說這家工廠的工人都很辛苦，可是老闆給的錢不多。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā gōngchǎng de gōngrén dōu hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì lǎobǎn gěi de qián bù duō.
examples.english: I heard that the workers at this factory all work very hard, but the money the boss gives is not much.

examples.chinese: 聽說高鐵很快，你搭過沒有？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō gāotiě hěn kuài, nǐ dā guo méiyǒu?
examples.english: I heard the high-speed rail is very fast; have you ever taken it?

examples.chinese: 聽說小張離過三次婚，你想他還會再結婚嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng lí guò sān cì hūn, nǐ xiǎng tā hái huì zài jiéhūn ma?
examples.english: I heard Xiao Zhang has been divorced three times; do you think he will get married again?

examples.chinese: 謝先生是從很有名的學校畢業的，但是聽說因為吃不了苦，什麼工作都做得不久。
examples.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng shì cóng hěn yǒumíng de xuéxiào bìyè de, dànshì tīngshuō yīnwèi chī bùliǎo kǔ, shénme gōngzuò dōu zuò de bùjiǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Xie graduated from a very famous school, but I heard that because he can't endure hardship, he doesn't last long at any job.

examples.chinese: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?
examples.english: I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。
examples.pinyin: Yì tīngshuō táifēng kuài lái le, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù qù chāoshì qiǎnggòu shūcài, shuǐguǒ, pàomiàn děng shíwù.
examples.english: As soon as they heard that a typhoon was coming, many people rushed to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruit, instant noodles, and other foods.

examples.chinese: 有一些父母不讓孩子去夜店，主要是因為聽說那裡有人吸毒，也買得到毒品。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē fùmǔ bù ràng háizi qù yèdiàn, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi tīngshuō nàlǐ yǒu rén xīdú, yě mǎi de dào dúpǐn.
examples.english: Some parents don't let their children go to nightclubs, mainly because they've heard that people take drugs there and that drugs can be bought there.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Jīn líhūn le, nǐ zhīdào shì zěnme huí shì ma? B: Āi, zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐlái dōu yào guài Xiǎo Jīn, shéi jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚshēng ne!
examples.english: A: I heard Xiao Jin got divorced. Do you know what happened? B: Sigh, as a matter of fact, it's all Xiao Jin's fault—who told him to fall in love with another girl!

examples.chinese: 聽說天上的一天，差不多是人間的好幾十年。這裡的風景美極了，好像人間天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: 1. Tīngshuō tiānshàng de yì tiān, chàbuduō shì rénjiān de hǎo jǐ shí nián. 2. Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng měi jí le, hǎoxiàng rénjiān tiāntáng yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. I've heard that one day in heaven is about several decades in the human world. 2. The scenery here is extremely beautiful, as if it were a paradise on earth.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 這個公園裡有幾棵又高又大的樹。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge gōngyuán lǐ yǒu jǐ kē yòu gāo yòu dà de shù.
examples.english: In this park there are several tall and big trees.

examples.chinese: 童先生穿著一件綠色的襯衫，配上一條咖啡色的褲子，看起來真像一棵樹。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xiānsheng chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de chènshān, pèi shàng yī tiáo kāfēisè de kùzi, kàn qǐlái zhēn xiàng yī kē shù.
examples.english: Mr. Tong is wearing a green shirt, matched with a brown pair of pants; he really looks like a tree.

examples.chinese: 阿里山上的樹木又高又粗，好幾棵樹木的年齡都超過一千年了。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān shàng de shùmù yòu gāo yòu cū, hǎojǐ kē shùmù de niánlíng dōu chāoguò yīqiān nián le.
examples.english: The trees on Alishan are both tall and thick; several of them are over a thousand years old.

items.wordHook: a 木(tree) holds 果(fruit) on every bough → one 棵(measure word for trees).

examples.chinese: 這是燈籠。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì dēnglóng.
examples.english: This is a lantern.

examples.chinese: 燈籠上的小老虎好可愛。
examples.pinyin: Dēnglóng shàng de xiǎo lǎohǔ hǎo kě'ài.
examples.english: The little tiger on the lantern is so lovely.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 他在跟家人談事情，已經講了三十分鐘的話了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gēn jiārén tán shìqíng, yǐjīng jiǎngle sānshí fēnzhōng de huà le.
examples.english: He is discussing something with his family; he has already been talking for thirty minutes.

examples.chinese: 連經理很講話，開會時老是說個不停，別人都沒說話的分。
examples.pinyin: Lián jīnglǐ hěn jiǎng huà, kāihuì shí lǎoshì shuō gè bù tíng, biérén dōu méi shuōhuà de fèn.
examples.english: Manager Lian talks a lot; during meetings he never stops talking, and others have no share of the speaking.

examples.chinese: 坐火車時，一旁的旅客不停地講電話，吵得我受不了。
examples.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē shí, yīpáng de lǚkè bùtíng de jiǎng diànhuà, chǎo de wǒ shòubuliǎo.
examples.english: When I was on the train, the passenger beside me kept talking on the phone, making such a noise that I couldn't stand it.

items.wordHook: 講(talk) + 話(words) → talking words out loud: 講話(to talk).

examples.chinese: 念了一個小時的書以後，你最好休息十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Niàn le yī ge xiǎoshí de shū yǐhòu, nǐ zuìhǎo xiūxi shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: After studying for an hour, you had better rest for ten minutes.

examples.chinese: 畢業後要工作還是要繼續念書，我得好好地想想再選擇！
examples.pinyin: Bìyè hòu yào gōngzuò háishì yào jìxù niànshū, wǒ děi hǎohǎo de xiǎngxiang zài xuǎnzé!
examples.english: After graduation, whether to work or to continue studying, I must think it over carefully before choosing!

examples.chinese: 我的父母覺得出國念書才會有美好的未來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fùmǔ juéde chūguó niànshū cái huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái.
examples.english: My parents think that only by studying abroad will you have a bright future.

examples.chinese: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yīdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
examples.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

examples.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yīdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
examples.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

examples.chinese: 這篇作文的錯字太多了，所以分數不高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān zuòwén de cuòzì tài duō le, suǒyǐ fēnshù bù gāo.
examples.english: This essay has too many wrong characters, so the score is not high.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 那家報社非常細心，他們的文章從沒出現過一個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā bàoshè fēicháng xìxīn, tāmen de wénzhāng cóng méi chūxiànguò yí gè cuòzì.
examples.english: That newspaper publisher is very careful; their articles have never had a single typo.

examples.chinese: 很多大學生都打過工，因為得自己付生活費。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng dōu dǎ guò gōng, yīnwèi děi zìjǐ fù shēnghuófèi.
examples.english: Many university students have had part-time jobs because they have to pay their own living expenses.

examples.chinese: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier.

examples.chinese: 陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà. Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great. Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 有的父母讓孩子嘗試打工，是為了讓孩子更加獨立。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude fùmǔ ràng háizi chángshì dǎgōng, shì wèile ràng háizi gèngjiā dúlì.
examples.english: Some parents let their children try working part-time in order to make their children more independent.

examples.chinese: 利用暑期打工不只可以賺點兒零用錢，還可以增加工作經驗。
examples.pinyin: Lìyòng shǔqī dǎgōng bùzhǐ kěyǐ zhuàn diǎnr língyòngqián, hái kěyǐ zēngjiā gōngzuò jīngyàn.
examples.english: Taking a summer job during the summer vacation not only earns you some pocket money but also increases your work experience.

examples.chinese: 我去英國留學時，常利用週末到旅行社打工，帶觀光客到著名的景點觀光。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yīngguó liúxué shí, cháng lìyòng zhōumò dào lǚxíngshè dǎgōng, dài guānguāngkè dào zhùmíng de jǐngdiǎn guānguāng.
examples.english: When I studied abroad in the UK, I often used weekends to work part-time at a travel agency, taking tourists sightseeing to famous attractions.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"陳先生在醫院裡著急地等待小孩出生。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"有些人等待了一輩子，都等不到高升的機會。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng zài yīyuàn lǐ zháojí de děngdài xiǎohái chūshēng. Yǒuxiē rén děngdài le yíbèizi, dōu děng bú dào gāoshēng de jīhuì.
examples.english: Mr. Chen is anxiously waiting in the hospital for his child to be born. Some people wait their whole life and never get a chance for promotion.

examples.chinese: 碰到困難無法繼續前進時，暫時後退等待機會也是一種作法。
examples.pinyin: Pèngdào kùnnán wúfǎ jìxù qiánjìn shí, zànshí hòutuì děngdài jīhuì yě shì yī zhǒng zuòfǎ.
examples.english: When you encounter difficulties and cannot continue to advance, temporarily retreating and waiting for an opportunity is also a kind of approach.

examples.chinese: 有能力的人就算不幸失業了，將來還是有許多機會等待著他。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu nénglì de rén jiùsuàn bùxìng shīyè le, jiānglái háishì yǒu xǔduō jīhuì děngdàizhe tā.
examples.english: Even if capable people unfortunately lose their jobs, there are still many opportunities waiting for them in the future.

examples.chinese: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiānsheng bǎ zhè kuài mùtou kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo, zhège yìshù zuòpǐn wánchéng hòu, hái néng fàng zài měishùguǎn ne!
examples.english: Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird; after this artwork is finished, it can even be placed in an art museum!

examples.chinese: 姊姊覺得木頭地板很麻煩，因為得跪著擦才擦得乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie juéde mùtou dìbǎn hěn máfan, yīnwèi děi guì zhe cā cái cā de gānjìng.
examples.english: My older sister thinks wooden floors are troublesome because you have to kneel to wipe them to get them clean.

examples.chinese: 他利用石頭、木頭在山上建了一間美麗的小屋。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìyòng shítou, mùtou zài shān shàng jiàn le yī jiān měilì de xiǎowū.
examples.english: He used stones and wood to build a beautiful little house on the mountain.

examples.chinese: 她到印尼買了一些木頭做的禮品，加工後再到網路上售出。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào Yìnní mǎi le yīxiē mùtou zuò de lǐpǐn, jiāgōng hòu zài dào wǎnglù shàng shòuchū.
examples.english: She went to Indonesia and bought some gifts made of wood; after processing them, she then sold them online.

items.wordHook: Combining 木(wood) and 頭(the first): 木頭 means wood.

examples.chinese: 這部電影一點兒都不吸引人，就算錯過了也無所謂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yīdiǎnr dōu bù xīyǐn rén, jiùsuàn cuòguò le yě wúsuǒwèi.
examples.english: This movie is not attractive at all; even if you miss it, it doesn't matter.

examples.chinese: 學校的游泳比賽報名時間到今天截止，有興趣的同學別錯過了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de yóuyǒng bǐsài bàomíng shíjiān dào jīntiān jiézhǐ, yǒu xìngqù de tóngxué bié cuòguò le.
examples.english: Registration for the school's swimming competition closes today; classmates who are interested should not miss it.

examples.chinese: 有人一天到晚總看著手機，連錯過了精彩的生活時刻也不知道。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yìtiāndàowǎn zǒng kànzhe shǒujī, lián cuòguòle jīngcǎi de shēnghuó shíkè yě bù zhīdào.
examples.english: Some people always look at their phones from morning till night, and don't even know when they've missed wonderful moments in life.

examples.chinese: 為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
examples.pinyin: Wèile rénmín de jiànkāng, xǔduō guójiā dōu jìnzhǐ jìnkǒu shòudào huánjìng wūrǎn de nóngchǎnpǐn.
examples.english: For the health of the people, many countries prohibit the import of agricultural products that have been polluted by the environment.

examples.chinese: 為了安全起見，颱風天到山區露營的行為是被嚴格禁止的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile ānquán qǐjiàn, táifēng tiān dào shānqū lùyíng de xíngwéi shì bèi yángé jìnzhǐ de.
examples.english: For the sake of safety, camping in mountainous areas on typhoon days is strictly prohibited.

examples.chinese: 環保署規定禁止使用塑膠袋後，使用購物袋的人就漸漸增加了。
examples.pinyin: Huánbǎoshǔ guīdìng jìnzhǐ shǐyòng sùjiāodài hòu, shǐyòng gòuwùdài de rén jiù jiànjiàn zēngjiā le.
examples.english: After the Environmental Protection Administration banned the use of plastic bags, the number of people using shopping bags gradually increased.

examples.chinese: 根據醫院規定，進入病房後禁止大聲說話。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù yīyuàn guīdìng, jìnrù bìngfáng hòu jìnzhǐ dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.english: According to hospital regulations, after entering the ward, speaking loudly is prohibited.

examples.chinese: 人的性格主要是受成長環境的影響，跟性別沒有太大的關係。
examples.pinyin: Rén de xìnggé zhǔyào shì shòu chéngzhǎng huánjìng de yǐngxiǎng, gēn xìngbié méiyǒu tài dà de guānxi.
examples.english: A person's personality is mainly influenced by their growing environment, and has little to do with gender.

examples.chinese: 對任何人的態度，不該因種族、國籍或性別而不同。
examples.pinyin: Duì rènhé rén de tàidù, bù gāi yīn zhǒngzú, guójí huò xìngbié ér bùtóng.
examples.english: One's attitude toward anyone should not differ because of race, nationality, or gender.

examples.chinese: 這家國際企業因商品銷售情況不理想，決定退出亞洲市場。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā guójì qǐyè yīn shāngpǐn xiāoshòu qíngkuàng bù lǐxiǎng, juédìng tuìchū Yàzhōu shìchǎng.
examples.english: This international enterprise, because product sales were not ideal, decided to withdraw from the Asian market.

items.wordHook: A 雐(bird) flies off with funds: 虧(lose).
Before offering 雇(employment) to an applicant, turn your 頁(head) to carefully 顧(take into account) their qualifications.
